prerequisites: Minimum knowledge of core degree subjects is recommended.

learning_outcomes.text: Manage occupational risk prevention in a company by adopting the preventive activity modality that best suits the organization's characteristics.
Consult legislative references on occupational risk prevention in the company.
Handle basic terminology related to general concepts regarding occupational risk prevention in the business world.

Identify the scope of action and basic tools of the three technical preventive disciplines (safety at work, industrial hygiene, and applied ergonomics and psychosociology), distinguishing between them and occupational medicine (the only non-technical discipline).
Utilize the main preventive techniques of a company (occupational risk assessment, investigation of work accidents, mainly).
Ability to draft and develop projects in the field of industrial engineering (especially everything related to the safety and health plan, which must accompany every engineering project).
Ability to direct the activities that are the object of engineering projects, linked in this particular case to the field of occupational risk prevention.

Knowledge in basic and technological subjects, which enables them to learn new methods and theories, and provides them with versatility to adapt to new situations, always within the scope of occupational risk prevention.
Ability to solve problems with initiative, decision-making, creativity, and critical reasoning.
Ability to communicate and transmit knowledge, skills, and abilities in the field of Industrial Engineering, both orally and in writing, and to all types of audiences.
Knowledge for carrying out measurements, calculations, and valuations related to occupational risk prevention in the company.
Ability to manage specifications, regulations, and mandatory standards, applying compliance with current legislation in the proper management of occupational risk prevention in a company.
Ability to analyze and assess the social impact of technical solutions.
Ability to organize and plan in the field of business, and other institutions and organizations.

Ability to apply acquired knowledge in occupational risk prevention and to solve problems in new or little-known environments within broader and multidisciplinary contexts, being able to integrate this knowledge.
Ability for occupational risk prevention and the protection of workers' and users' health and safety.
Adequate knowledge of the concept of a company, its institutional and legal framework; organization and management of companies.
Knowledge and abilities to organize and manage projects.

syllabus_topics: Basic concepts and legal framework of reference
Development through Royal Decrees and technical guides
Occupational disease: classification and agents that cause them
Causes and consequences vs. Prevention and protection
Planning of prevention in the company
Planning of preventive activity in the company
Safety and health plan or occupational risk prevention management system
Preventive disciplines and modalities of preventive activity
Different modalities of organizing preventive activity
Work equipment and personal protective equipment
Specific occupational risk assessments (manual handling of loads, data display screens)
Definition and classification of the different branches of industrial hygiene
Agents in the work environment and preventive measures against them
Definition and classification of the different techniques of occupational medicine

assessment_methods.method: Individual Study/Basic Safety and Health Plan (ESS)

assessment_rules: For continuous assessment, the final grade is calculated as 0.1·ESS + 0.1·TG + 0.1·TEST + 0.7·PORTA. For ordinary evaluation (without continuous assessment), the grade is 0.1·ESS + 0.1·TG + 0.8·EX (final exam). For continuous assessment, attendance to more than 80% of classes is mandatory, and an incomplete portfolio (PORTA) is not valid. The completion and attendance of all practical work presentations are mandatory to pass the subject. For differentiated evaluation and extraordinary exams, the theoretical part will be assessed by a final exam (EX) instead of the portfolio and basic knowledge test, with the practical part (ESS + TG) still required.
